metadata.methods_description: EEG signals were recorded using a 32-channel ActiChamp system (Brain Products GmbH, Germany) with active Ag/AgCl electrodes positioned according to the international 10–20 system. Electrode impedance was maintained below 15 kΩ. Signals were sampled at 500 Hz and filtered between 0.5 and 50 Hz. Each recording session lasted approximately nine minutes, comprising four blocks: two eyes-open blocks (2 minutes 15 seconds each) and two eyes-closed blocks (2 minutes 15 seconds each). Recordings were performed at two time points: before and immediately after the study intervention.

citation_details.abstract: Pyp-EEG v2.0.0 This release introduces the first major public reorganization of the pipeline, with updated naming, improved documentation, a unified execution entry point, and revised time-series handling. Highlights Added run.py for one-command pipeline execution Renamed and standardized plotting scripts Renamed the project to Pyp-EEG Reorganized time-series outputs and filenames Added MDMP workflow support and documentation Added dataset provenance and OpenNeuro citation to the README Corrected local time indexing in ts_power_long.csv Breaking changes plot_timeseries_4blocks.py → plot_timeseries.py plot_topomaps_grid_EO_EC.py → plot_topomaps_grid.py plot_mirror_EO_EC_points.py → plot_mirror.py plot_heatmaps_mdmp.py → plot_mdmp_heatmaps.py Removed plot_timeseries_all_EC_EO.py Removed plot_heat_all_bands_timeseries.py results/plots/timeseries_4blocks/ was replaced by results/plots/timeseries/ ts_4blocks_all_bands_rois_relabs.csv was renamed to ts_all_bands_rois_relabs.csv ts4blocks_* figure names were renamed to ts_* t_sec in ts_power_long.csv now uses file-local time Notes This release is versioned as 2.0.0 because it includes breaking changes in script names, output paths, and time-series export behavior. The pipeline was developed and tested with OpenNeuro dataset ds006801: 10.18112/openneuro.ds006801.v1.0.0
